rules.title: docker build with --no-cache

estimate.assumption: layer cache hits skip dependency install layers; 0.6 assumes dependency layers dominate

rules.why: Every build redoes all layers, including unchanged dependency installs.
rules.fix: Drop --no-cache; order Dockerfile so lockfile COPY + install precede source COPY; use cache mounts.
rules.after: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -t app .   # with RUN --mount=type=cache

rules.title: Legacy docker builder in use

detector.regex: legacy builder is deprecated|DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0|Sending build context to Docker daemon

estimate.assumption: BuildKit parallelises stages and caches better; gain depends on the Dockerfile

rules.why: The output says the classic builder is running, which lacks parallel stages and cache mounts.
rules.fix: Enable BuildKit/buildx and trim the build context with .dockerignore.

rules.title: Build caches wiped (cargo/gradle/go)

estimate.assumption: an incremental build is commonly 3-10x faster than a clean one

rules.why: Clean builds throw away incremental artefacts and the module/test cache.
rules.fix: Do not clean routinely; use sccache / the Gradle build cache and keep target/ and ~/.gradle between runs.
rules.after: cargo build   # with sccache; clean only on toolchain changes
